question: Which of the following Articles of the Indian Constitution contains Fundamental Duties?
question_hi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद में मौलिक कर्तव्यों का उल्लेख है?
verified_source: SSC CGL 2024 Official Key • NCERT Class 11 Polity

revision_notes.label: Part IV-A
revision_notes.detail: Article 51A is the only Article in Part IV-A.

revision_notes.label: 42nd Amendment (1976)
revision_notes.detail: Added 10 duties via Swaran Singh Committee (USSR).

revision_notes.label: 86th Amendment (2002)
revision_notes.detail: Added 11th duty — Art. 51A(k) (education, ages 6–14).

revision_notes.label: Exam Trap
revision_notes.detail: Art. 51 is DPSP (International Peace), NOT Fundamental Duties!

question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution empowers High Courts to issue writs similar to Article 32?
question_hi: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद उच्च न्यायालयों को अनुच्छेद 32 के समान रिट जारी करने की शक्ति देता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL 2024 Official Key • NCERT Class 11 Polity

revision_notes.label: High Court Writs
revision_notes.detail: Article 226 empowers High Courts to issue 5 types of writs.

revision_notes.label: Supreme Court Writs
revision_notes.detail: Article 32 grants writ jurisdiction to the Supreme Court.

revision_notes.label: Wider Scope
revision_notes.detail: Art. 226 covers both Fundamental Rights and other legal rights.

revision_notes.label: 5 Writs
revision_notes.detail: Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Certiorari, Quo Warranto.

question: Sattriya, one of India's classical dance forms, originated in which Indian state?
question_hi: भारत का शास्त्रीय नृत्य 'सत्त्रिया' किस राज्य से संबंधित है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Sangeet Natak Akademi

revision_notes.label: Founder
revision_notes.detail: Introduced in the 15th century by Vaishnava saint Srimanta Sankardev.

revision_notes.label: Recognition
revision_notes.detail: Recognized as a classical dance by Sangeet Natak Akademi in 2000.

revision_notes.label: Origin
revision_notes.detail: Evolved inside Assamese monasteries known as 'Sattras'.

revision_notes.label: 8 Classical Dances
revision_notes.detail: Bharatanatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, Sattriya.

question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution directs the State to organize Village Panchayats?
question_hi: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राज्य को ग्राम पंचायतों का गठन करने का निर्देश देता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Polity

revision_notes.label: Gandhian DPSP
revision_notes.detail: Article 40 (Part IV) promotes Gram Panchayats as self-government units.

revision_notes.label: 73rd Amendment (1992)
revision_notes.detail: Gave constitutional status to Panchayati Raj (Part IX, 11th Schedule).

revision_notes.label: Art. 44 Trap
revision_notes.detail: Article 44 deals with Uniform Civil Code (UCC), frequently asked in SSC.

revision_notes.label: First State
revision_notes.detail: Rajasthan (Nagaur, 1959) was the first state to adopt Panchayati Raj.

question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution is the Finance Commission constituted?
question_hi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद के तहत वित्त आयोग का गठन किया जाता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Constitution of India

revision_notes.label: Appointed By
revision_notes.detail: President of India constitutes it every 5 years (or earlier).

revision_notes.label: Composition
revision_notes.detail: 1 Chairman + 4 other members; quasi-judicial constitutional body.

revision_notes.label: Main Role
revision_notes.detail: Recommends distribution of net tax proceeds between Centre and States.

revision_notes.label: Other Options
revision_notes.detail: Art. 263: Inter-State Council | Art. 315: UPSC | Art. 324: Election Commission.

question: In which year was the historic Battle of Plassey fought between Siraj-ud-Daulah and the British?
question_hi: सिराजुद्दौला और अंग्रेजों के बीच ऐतिहासिक प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 8 History

revision_notes.label: Date & Place
revision_notes.detail: 23 June 1757, on the banks of the Bhagirathi River in Bengal.

revision_notes.label: Key Leaders
revision_notes.detail: Robert Clive (East India Company) defeated Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah.

revision_notes.label: Betrayal
revision_notes.detail: Mir Jafar (commander of Nawab's army) sided with the British.

revision_notes.label: Exam Trap
revision_notes.detail: 1761: 3rd Battle of Panipat | 1764: Battle of Buxar.

question: Deficiency of which vitamin causes Scurvy, characterized by bleeding gums?
question_hi: किस विटामिन की कमी से स्कर्वी रोग होता है (मसूड़ों से खून आना)?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 6 Science

revision_notes.label: Chemical Name
revision_notes.detail: Vitamin C is scientifically known as Ascorbic Acid.

revision_notes.label: Solubility
revision_notes.detail: Water-soluble vitamin (along with Vitamin B-complex).

revision_notes.label: Rich Sources
revision_notes.detail: Amla (Indian gooseberry), lemon, orange, and guava.

revision_notes.label: Quick Match
revision_notes.detail: Vit A: Night Blindness | Vit B1: Beriberi | Vit D: Rickets.

question: Kaziranga National Park, famous for the one-horned rhinoceros, is located in which state?
question_hi: एक सींग वाले गैंडे के लिए प्रसिद्ध काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में स्थित है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 9 Geography

revision_notes.label: UNESCO Status
revision_notes.detail: Declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1985.

revision_notes.label: River Basin
revision_notes.detail: Lies in the floodplains of the Brahmaputra River.

revision_notes.label: Biodiversity
revision_notes.detail: Hosts the world's largest population of Great Indian One-Horned Rhinos.

revision_notes.label: Assam Parks
revision_notes.detail: Manas, Nameri, Orang, Dibru-Saikhowa, Raimona, Dehing Patkai.

question: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) was established in 1935 on the recommendation of which Commission?
question_hi: भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI) की स्थापना 1935 में किस आयोग की सिफारिश पर हुई थी?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • RBI Official History

revision_notes.label: Established
revision_notes.detail: 1 April 1935 under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

revision_notes.label: Nationalization
revision_notes.detail: Nationalized on 1 January 1949; HQ moved from Kolkata to Mumbai in 1937.

revision_notes.label: First Governor
revision_notes.detail: Sir Osborne Smith (first Indian Governor: C. D. Deshmukh).

revision_notes.label: Exam Trap
revision_notes.detail: Sarkaria Commission (1983) was for Centre–State relations.

question: Which landmark Supreme Court judgment established the 'Basic Structure Doctrine' of the Indian Constitution?
question_hi: सुप्रीम कोर्ट के किस ऐतिहासिक फैसले ने संविधान के 'मूल संरचना सिद्धांत' को स्थापित किया?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Polity

revision_notes.label: Largest Bench
revision_notes.detail: Decided by a historic 13-judge Supreme Court bench (7–6 majority).

revision_notes.label: Core Ruling
revision_notes.detail: Parliament can amend the Constitution under Art. 368, but cannot alter its Basic Structure.

revision_notes.label: Minerva Mills (1980)
revision_notes.detail: Reinforced balance between Fundamental Rights and DPSP.

revision_notes.label: Maneka Gandhi (1978)
revision_notes.detail: Expanded Article 21 (Right to Life & Personal Liberty).

question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution gives the President the power to grant pardons?
question_hi: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को क्षमादान की शक्ति प्रदान करता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • Constitution of India

revision_notes.label: President's Power
revision_notes.detail: Article 72 covers pardon, reprieve, respite, remission, and commutation.

revision_notes.label: Governor Trap
revision_notes.detail: Article 161 gives pardoning power to the Governor (cannot pardon death sentence).

revision_notes.label: Art. 61
revision_notes.detail: Procedure for impeachment of the President of India.

revision_notes.label: Art. 123
revision_notes.detail: Power of the President to promulgate Ordinances.

question: Who founded the 'Brahmo Samaj' in 1828 to reform Hindu society and abolish Sati?
question_hi: 1828 में हिंदू समाज में सुधार और सती प्रथा के अंत के लिए 'ब्रह्म समाज' की स्थापना किसने की?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 8 History

revision_notes.label: Founded
revision_notes.detail: 20 August 1828 in Calcutta (earlier Atmiya Sabha in 1815).

revision_notes.label: Abolition of Sati
revision_notes.detail: Passed in 1829 under Governor-General Lord William Bentinck.

revision_notes.label: Arya Samaj Trap
revision_notes.detail: Swami Dayanand Saraswati founded Arya Samaj in 1875 (Bombay).

revision_notes.label: Satyashodhak Samaj
revision_notes.detail: Founded by Jyotiba Phule in 1873 in Pune.

question: What is the SI unit of electrical resistance?
question_hi: विद्युत प्रतिरोध (Electrical Resistance) का SI मात्रक क्या है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 10 Science

revision_notes.label: Ohm's Law
revision_notes.detail: V = I × R, where R is resistance measured in Ohms (Ω).

revision_notes.label: Resistivity Trap
revision_notes.detail: SI unit of Resistivity is Ohm-metre (Ω·m), NOT just Ohm.

revision_notes.label: Ampere & Volt
revision_notes.detail: Ampere (A) = Electric Current | Volt (V) = Potential Difference.

revision_notes.label: Watt (W)
revision_notes.detail: SI unit of Electric Power (P = V × I).

question: Which river is known as 'Dakshin Ganga' (Ganga of the South) in India?
question_hi: भारत में किस नदी को 'दक्षिण गंगा' के नाम से जाना जाता है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 9 Geography

revision_notes.label: Origin
revision_notes.detail: Rises from Trimbakeshwar in Nashik district, Maharashtra.

revision_notes.label: Length
revision_notes.detail: Largest Peninsular river (~1,465 km), draining into the Bay of Bengal.

revision_notes.label: Major Tributaries
revision_notes.detail: Purna, Wardha, Pranhita, Manjra, Wainganga, and Penganga.

revision_notes.label: Exam Trap
revision_notes.detail: Godavari = 'Dakshin Ganga' (NCERT) | Kaveri = 'Ganga of the South' in some state exams.

question: Which Schedule of the Indian Constitution contains the Anti-Defection Law?
question_hi: भारतीय संविधान की किस अनुसूची में दल-बदल विरोधी कानून का प्रावधान है?
verified_source: SSC CGL Official PYQ • NCERT Class 11 Polity

revision_notes.label: Added By
revision_notes.detail: 52nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1985 (Rajiv Gandhi govt).

revision_notes.label: Deciding Authority
revision_notes.detail: Speaker (Lok Sabha / Assembly) or Chairman (Rajya Sabha).

revision_notes.label: 8th & 9th Schedules
revision_notes.detail: 8th = 22 Official Languages | 9th = Land Reforms (1st Amendment, 1951).

revision_notes.label: 11th & 12th
revision_notes.detail: 11th = Panchayats (73rd) | 12th = Municipalities (74th).
